description: Pinned upstream Pi source for pi-agents. Every field here is verified fail-closed by prepare.mjs and build.mjs; nothing is resolved at build time.

upstream.commitProvenance: Tag v1.4.0. npm records no gitHead for @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@1.4.0, so the tag is the pin. An unpatched build of it (Slurm job 4188971) was byte-identical to the published pi-coding-agent, pi-tui, pi-ai and pi-agent-core 1.4.0 packages apart from the LICENSE this build adds.

observedTag.name: v1.4.0
observedTag.note: No npm gitHead exists for this version; the tag is the pin.

license.note: Root license of the pinned monorepo. Upstream packs no per-package license file, so build.mjs copies this verified notice into every packed package root as LICENSE and verifies its digest inside each produced tarball. Transitive dependency notices are an npm packaging concern and are not asserted here.

generatedInputs.reason: packages/ai/src/providers/data/** is gitignored upstream and generated by `npm run generate-models`, which fetches live models.dev data. The pinned commit therefore does not build from source alone, and a live fetch is both non-reproducible and currently red at this commit (TS2353 in packages/ai/src/providers/cloudflare-ai-gateway.ts, because today's catalog no longer carries the openai-completions models the pinned shard types expect). This pins that generated input to the published artifact of the same version instead.
generatedInputs.buildKindNote: This makes the recipe a hybrid build: pinned source plus this pinned release-generated data. It is not a source-only reconstruction of the release, and no byte reproducibility of the published packages is claimed from it.
generatedInputs.mappingNote: Only this one archive member directory is taken, and it maps onto the one gitignored source directory it was generated into. Nothing else from the published artifact enters the build: every executable file, every other package and the bundled CLI are rebuilt from the pinned source.
generatedInputs.noFallback: There is no live model-data fallback and no fuzzy match. A registry, tarball, file-set or per-file digest mismatch aborts the build before anything is copied into the source tree.

license.note: The published @earendil-works/pi-ai artifact carries the same MIT license as the pinned source; see NOTICE.md. Data derived from the models.dev catalog is upstream's own generated output, redistributed here only as a pinned build input.

upstreamManifest.note: Upstream's own manifest of the generated data. `packages/ai` build:offline revalidates it through scripts/check-model-data.ts, so a substituted catalog fails the build rather than the type checker.

build.installNote: Runs against the verified upstream package-lock.json. Scripts stay off: the pinned lock already carries every platform binary this build needs (measured on worker 3735114).
build.stepsNote: Upstream's own build:offline order at 1.4.0, minus chord, durable and env, which no packed package depends on. packages/ai uses build:offline so no step reaches the network for a catalog. The final step runs build:unbundled and then scripts/build-coding-agent-bundle.mjs, so the bundled CLI is rebuilt, not reused.
build.checksNote: Upstream's own guard (check:install-lock:coding-agent) that the published coding-agent install lock still describes the built dependency graph. 1.4.0 removed the separate shrinkwrap generator.
build.packNote: The internal runtime cohort of @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@1.4.0: its four internal dependencies plus pi-telemetry, which pi-ai depends on. 1.4.0 no longer has pi-protocol or pi-client.

buildKind: hybrid: pinned upstream source plus pinned release-generated data (see generatedInputs). Not a source-only reconstruction; byte reproducibility of the published packages is not claimed.
